skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-library-design
skills.description: Designs pooled sgRNA libraries for CRISPR knockout, interference (CRISPRi), activation (CRISPRa), Cas12a multiplex, base-editor, and prime-editor screens: on-target/off-target scoring, TSS-relative positioning, control-guide composition, oligo cloning architecture.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-screen-qc
skills.description: Quality control for pooled CRISPR screens: library representation, Gini index, replicate concordance, essentialome precision-recall against CEGv2, Cas9 cut-toxicity, copy-number amplicon detection, bottleneck propagation, and MOI verification.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-mageck-analysis
skills.description: Analyzes pooled CRISPR screens with MAGeCK: RRA two-condition and MLE multi-condition workflows, normalization choice, sgRNA efficiency injection, paired/time-course/drug-screen design, MAGeCKFlute visualization, and decision logic vs JACKS/BAGEL2/drugZ/Chronos.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-bagel-essentiality
skills.description: Identifies essential genes from CRISPR-Cas9 fitness screens using BAGEL2's Bayesian classifier over per-sgRNA fold changes, calibrated against CEGv2/NEGv1: fc+bf+pr workflow, tumor-suppressor detection, BF calibration, and reproducibility.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-drugz-chemogenomic
skills.description: Analyzes CRISPR drug-modifier (chemogenomic) screens with drugZ, a bidirectional Z-score method identifying synthetic-lethal sensitizing genes and resistance-conferring suppressor genes from vehicle vs drug comparisons.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-jacks-analysis
skills.description: Runs JACKS (Joint Analysis of CRISPR/Cas9 Knockout Screens), modeling per-sgRNA log-fold-change as gene-essentiality times guide-efficacy, with hierarchical efficacy priors shared across screens using the same library.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-copy-number-correction
skills.description: Corrects the gene-independent copy-number artifact in CRISPR-Cas9 screens where amplified loci appear essential from DNA-damage burden: CRISPRcleanR, CERES, Chronos, the decision tree, and a two-rule copy-number-bias diagnostic.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-hit-calling
skills.description: Cross-method decision tree for calling hits in pooled CRISPR screens: catalogs MAGeCK RRA/MLE, BAGEL2, drugZ, JACKS, Chronos, CERES, their designs, failure modes, reconciliation on disagreement, multiple-testing thresholds, and consensus-hit strategy.

skills.name: bio-workflows-crispr-screen-pipeline
skills.description: End-to-end pooled CRISPR screen analysis from FASTQ to hit genes: library QC, guide counting, six-stage screen QC, method-matched hit calling across MAGeCK/BAGEL2/drugZ/JACKS/Chronos, copy-number and batch correction, and tier-based cross-method consensus.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-batch-correction
skills.description: Batch effect correction for CRISPR screens covering ComBat empirical-Bayes, RUV, SVA, control-sgRNA normalization, and the model-based alternative of batch-as-covariate in MAGeCK MLE or Chronos, plus diagnosis and decision-tree guidance.

skills.name: bio-experimental-design-batch-design
skills.description: Designs genomics experiments so technical nuisance variation (batch, lane, plate, operator, reagent lot) is balanced against the biological variable of interest, using constrained sample-to-batch assignment and a decision table for downstream correction.

skills.name: bio-pathway-go-enrichment
skills.description: Runs Gene Ontology over-representation analysis (ORA) on a gene list with clusterProfiler enrichGO: universe/background handling, ontology defaults, p-value adjustment, GO-DAG redundancy, gene-length bias, and ID mapping.

skills.name: bio-pathway-gsea
skills.description: Tests a ranked gene vector for coordinated expression shifts in GO/KEGG/Reactome/MSigDB gene sets with clusterProfiler's gseGO/gseKEGG/gsePathway/GSEA and scores per-sample pathway activity with ssGSEA and GSVA.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-crispresso-editing
skills.description: Quantifies CRISPR editing outcomes with CRISPResso2 across Cas9-nuclease (indels, HDR), CBE/ABE base editors, and prime editor modes: single-amplicon, batch, pooled, WGS off-target, and comparison workflows plus quantification-window math and failure diagnosis.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-base-editing-analysis
skills.description: Analyzes base-editing screens for variant function: library design, CBE vs ABE chemistry choice, editing-window math, bystander-edit quantification, sgRNA-efficiency filtering before hit calling, indel byproduct interpretation, and ClinVar/COSMIC annotation.

skills.name: bio-crispr-screens-prime-editing-screens
skills.description: Designs and analyzes pooled prime-editor (PE) screens: pegRNA design with PRIDICT/PRIDICT2, PE2/PE3/PE3b/PEmax chemistry choice, MOSAIC saturation mutagenesis, CRISPResso2 quantification of intended-edit vs scaffold-incorporation vs indel, and cross-modal validation with base-editor screens.
